answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 14 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 500 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. The grove is the check that cannot be faked, the dawn is the price the attacker pays, and the jade is the record that outlives the epoch.
